breakdown.description: The inward hole pressure is reversed to an outward traction by changing the sign relative to the solid normal
breakdown.reason: The original prompt incorrectly defined an inward pressure on the hole boundary with the formula `t = +p*n` (where n is the outward normal), which would result in an outward force. The ground truth corrects this to `t = -p*n`. The generated specification repeated the original error, stating 'implemented as a traction term t = +p * n, where n is the outward-pointing normal vector from the solid domain.' This fails to resolve the inconsistency.
